- 2022: $513,983M  
- 2023: $574,785M  
- 2024: $637,959M [DOC]

Year-over-year growth rates (using those figures):
- 2022 → 2023: (574,785 − 513,983) / 513,983 ≈ 11.83% [DOC]
- 2023 → 2024: (637,959 − 574,785) / 574,785 ≈ 10.99% [DOC]

The growth rate declined from about 11.8% to about 11.0%, meaning revenue growth decelerated year-over-year between 2023 and 2024. The periods are consecutive fiscal years on the same consolidated net sales basis, so they are directly comparable. [DOC]

ANSWER: Decelerated
